You'll use your hands. You'll open your mind. You'll be taught by faculty who bring real-world experience into the classroom -- and you will have the chance to apply that learning through work placements, internships, co-op opportunities or intensive applied projects.
Explore Fleming's diplomas, certificates and degree pathways to help you gain the skills required to achieve your career goals. And explore our welcoming learning communities where people will know you by name. Regardless of your background, experience or age, you are welcomed here. You'll feel at home here.
